system.name: SemiDFL
system.one_liner: A semi-supervised method for decentralized federated learning that builds consensus in data and model spaces through neighbour pseudo-labelling, consensus MixUp and adaptive aggregation.

content.variant_note: six numbered chevron steps in a ring around a five-client miniature, with zoom insets only for the three contribution steps; panel (a) is the client topology
content.argues: Decentralised clients with labelled, mixed or unlabelled data loop through six steps, three of them new (neighbourhood pseudo-labelling, consensus MixUp, adaptive aggregation), to reach consensus in data and model spaces.
content.subject: ten-client communication topology and a six-step training ring with three zoom insets on the contribution steps

lessons.what_to_learn: Give detailed zoom insets only to the steps the paper claims as new and tie each to its ring segment with one dashed leader line, so the figure itself marks the contribution. Write toy numbers into the insets (weights that sum to 1) so an operation can be followed by hand.
lessons.suits: Iterative multi-step training loops where only a few steps are new and a miniature of the topology can sit in the middle.

summary: SemiDFL is a semi-supervised method for decentralized federated learning, where clients without a server hold labeled, mixed or unlabeled data. Figure 1 has two panels. (a) is a ten-client topology whose icons are coloured by data situation and joined by double-headed arrows. (b) is a ring of six numbered chevron steps around a five-client miniature: pseudo-labeling, generator training, MixUp, classifier training, classifier evaluation and adaptive aggregation. Three dashed insets, tied to the ring by leader lines, open up only the three steps that the caption names as contributions: neighbour pseudo-labeling, consensus MixUp of labeled, pseudo and generated data, and aggregation with toy weights 0.1 to 0.4.
summary_zh: SemiDFL 是面向去中心化联邦学习的半监督方法。图分两部分：(a) 十个客户端按数据情况着色、用双向箭头相连；(b) 六个编号步骤围成圆环，三处虚线放大框只展开论文声明的三个贡献步骤（邻域伪标签、共识 MixUp、自适应聚合）。
notes: The prior labels said two insets; there are three, tied by dashed leader lines to steps 6 (top), 1 (middle) and 3 (bottom), which fits their content. Panel (b)'s ring segments and the centre disc are bitmap pieces with glow effects (checked in the SVG: 70-88 pt rasters); histograms are vector. The meaning of the dot rows on client bases and of the light-blue / purple alternation of the step numbers is not stated.
